name: Ava Capital Plc
source: Ava Capital Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, hosted on the issuer own investor relations site; figures are the COMPANY column in N thousands, which is the reporting entity the NGX ticker resolves to
unit: NGN, reported in N thousands. Revenue is the printed Total operating income line. Operating Expenses is the sum of the printed Personnel expenses, Depreciation on property and equipment, Operating expenses and Impairment charge for credit loss lines. The Company column carries no interest expense, so Operating Profit equals the printed Profit before tax.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFrom: Personnel expenses + Depreciation on property and equipment + Operating expenses + Impairment charge for credit loss (printed lines)

checks.revenueLessOpex: 1270679 less 596023 equals 674656, the printed Profit before tax; 331302 less 334941 equals -3639, the printed Profit before tax
checks.pbtLessTax: 674656 less 173978 equals 500678, the printed Profit after tax; -3639 less 17317 equals -20956, the printed Profit after tax

note: Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are withheld because the issuer prints no cost of sales line; it is a capital market operator. EPS withheld: the printed basic and diluted earnings per share line could not be read unambiguously across its Group and Company columns.
